decisive_items: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma diagnosed 4 years ago
diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium
response.rationale: History of DLBCL with new right atrial masses and hypermetabolic activity on PET-CT is highly specific for cardiac lymphoma.

rejected.why: Non-specific symptoms and elevated NT-proBNP; does not explain the right atrial mass or PET avidity.
No history of structural heart disease; the mass and PET findings are not explained by chemotherapy-induced cardiomyopathy.
ECG findings are non-specific; the history of lymphoma and imaging findings strongly favor cardiac lymphoma over amyloidosis.
